title: BiocatalystSource
description: Information about the source and procurement of the biocatalyst.

purchased_details.title: purchased_details
purchased_details.description: Specific details relevant to commercially purchased biocatalysts.

self_produced_details.title: self_produced_details
self_produced_details.description: Specific details relevant to biocatalysts produced in-house.

source_type.title: source_type
source_type.description: Whether the biocatalyst was purchased from a supplier or produced in-house.

supplier.title: supplier
supplier.description: Name of the commercial supplier or source of the biocatalyst.

PurchasedDetails.title: PurchasedDetails
PurchasedDetails.description: Detailed information for commercially purchased biocatalysts.

formulation.title: formulation
formulation.description: Physical form of the purchased biocatalyst (dissolved, powder, etc.).

purity.title: purity
purity.description: Purity of the purchased biocatalyst as specified by the supplier, typically as a percentage.

purity_specification.title: purity_specification
purity_specification.description: Method or specification used to determine the purity (e.g., SDS-PAGE, activity assay).

reference.title: reference
reference.description: Product code, catalog number, or other reference identifier from the supplier.

SelfProducedDetails.title: SelfProducedDetails
SelfProducedDetails.description: Detailed information for biocatalysts produced in-house.

formulation.title: formulation
formulation.description: Physical form of the self-produced biocatalyst after purification and processing.

plasmid_specifications.title: plasmid_specifications
plasmid_specifications.description: Details about the plasmid construction, including vector backbone, promoter, and other relevant features.

purification_method.title: purification_method
purification_method.description: Method(s) used to purify the enzyme after expression.

purity.title: purity
purity.description: Achieved purity of the self-produced biocatalyst, typically as a percentage.

purity_specification.title: purity_specification
purity_specification.description: Method used to determine the purity of the self-produced enzyme.

sequence_plasmid.title: sequence_plasmid
sequence_plasmid.description: Sequence of the plasmid used for enzyme expression.
